profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Disney Parks, Experiences and Products
profile.summary: To succeed in an environment of growth and excellence and establish a career which provides me satisfaction.  One that helps me achieve personal as well as organizational goals which will utilize my extensive technical skills and will lead me to an innovative work environment.

positions.title: Quality Assurance Software Testing and Release Manager
positions.description:
•	Established the company’s Quality Assurance standards, which included creation of manual and automated test cases and gathering key business requirements.
•	Develop and implement an innovate strategy for testing and validation of all product changes.
•	Work with Development and Product Management to ensure appropriate test plan creation and execution collaborates with software product release.
•	Coordinate release content and effort based on the user story backlog, pending service requests, third party applications, or operating system updates.
•	Manual testing of the entire application and web based GUI.
•	Plan test cases from newly developed software releases from two different offsite developers.
•	Gather business requirements to satisfy the needs of both the operations team and information technology teams while maintaining projects in scope and within budgets.
•	Configure and manage both Ruby on Rails and Java applications for guest facing software.
•	Setup and configure Dell PowerEdge servers and configure Windows IIS services for back-end software processes.
•	Active member in daily Scrum in an agile development environment.
•	Perform Functional, System, Integration, Regression and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) with both in-house and with third party business clients (cruiseline).
•	Prepare user-targeted documentation of all deliveries to ensure proper and optimal use of applications.
•	Solid knowledge of MSSQL querying and basic scripting.
•	Responsible for coordinating software release cycles which are in alignment with business objectives, in addition to software compatibility.
•	Work with Linux (Ubuntu) VM (networking configurations, installation, and maintenance).
•	Conduct research on new hardware for integration with production systems – scoped latest micro computers, monitors, and servers.

positions.title: Digital Systems QA Specialist
positions.description:
•	Founded the quality assurance program for the organization by creating manual and automated test cases while incorporating new test management software
•	Execute and plan all newly developed software releases from two different developers
•	Work with both Ruby on Rails and Java application for our guest facing software and Windows IIS services for our backend processes
•	Experience working in an Agile/Scrum development process
•	Solid knowledge of SQL and scripting
•	Provide staff with technical support ranging from computer hardware issues  to complex server/application debugging
•	Organize the release management and execution of software releases. which is on 16 different environments. Planned releases are scheduled according to business needs and company goals
•	Establish and manage a structured testing environment
•	Manage various projects with multiple stakeholders and vendors while adhering to set schedules
•	Configure robust standardized testing environments that integrate multiple products and ensure full interoperability of products
•	Develop quality assurance standards and identify and implement test plans
•	Identify new bugs or potential system flaws and communicate with developers to ensure prompt correction of defects
•	Configure predictable, controlled delivery cycles that deliver the tested product on board and ensure uniformity of product versions
•	Configure servers (Windows Server 2012 R2) and install IIS sites - install vendor software on server/production for testing
•	Assist with troubleshooting from tickets opened by users and forward bugs to developers with the aim of zero delay and downtime of production systems
•	Conduct research on new hardware for integration with production systems - scope latest micro computers, monitors, peripherals, etc
•	Prepare user-targeted documentation of all deliveries to ensure proper and optimal use of system
•	Play a key role in deployment schedule and implementation of new releases

positions.title: Qa Analyst
positions.description:
•	Define and document the business processes necessary to support the operational functions of a Quality Assurance department
•	Creates manual and automated test scripts based on business functionality and executes the acceptance testing process to ensure compliance with the requested functionality
•	Designs and implements automation scripts to provide functional test coverage of business requirements for all applications supported by Interval IT (Client Server, Peoplesoft, Internet/Java/Web Services and AS400)
•	Perform and participate in all testing phases (automated and manual) to ensure that the system performs in a manner consistent with the design requirements
•	Monitor and track all defects found in applications via Jira system
•	Participate in Disaster Recovery testing for IT department
•	Work with the business in the UAT testing to meet Release deadlines
•	Responsible for verifying the code fixes, ensuring that functionality is working as expected and that related functionality has not been broken because of the fix
•	Perform manual and automated testing for major deployments and validate data
•	Testing mobile functionality on devices such as Apple iPhone and Android Galaxy phones. Including regression application testing and app services
•	Project lead for IVR automation testing utilizing CallMaster Hammer application

positions.title: Supervisor
positions.description:
•	Mentored, motivated, and directed 15+ advisors focusing on departmental budget goals, service levels, customer service and ensure compliance of all call center policies and procedures.
•	Developed team members to exceed department sales revenue by 135% year over year from 2010 to 2011 with revenue generated from membership renewals and vacation exchanges. 
•	Met and exceeded departmental goals for 11 out of 12 months in 2012, generating a 175% increase in reservations and membership renewal sales revenues as earned additional income for meeting goals.
•	Consistent top producer in travel, reservations, and membership sales while in the position of Vacation Advisor which lead to promotion of Supervisor after only 16 months.
•	Testing and certification of operational systems for call center and responsible for reporting glitches using JIRA.
•	Department technical “go to guy” – assist in basic computer problems and handle advanced technical support issues with company reservations system and Noble dialer system.
•	Testing and reporting on the company disaster recovery plan yearly.
•	Maintain positive business rapport with internal and external customers by dealing effectively with other departments to resolve any customer issues.
•	Communicate with our clients to ensure that we are meeting key performance indicators and that our clients receive the highest level of service.
•	Monitor service levels, sales budgets, and call times on a daily basis.
•	Create and carry out department contest to increase revenue in efforts to meet departmental goals for management sales commission.
•	Conduct morning briefings daily to review sales goals and department budget standings.
•	Collecting of timeshare owner financial maintenance fees and loans, including negotiating payment plans and setting up new accounts. 
•	Hold training seminars of 50+ advisors to provide tips on how to improve advisor performance and department productivity.
